mapper.select: select count(id) from la_activity_task_relation relation where relation.is_delete = 0 and relation.activity_id = #{activityId}

select relation.task_item_id, relation.sorts from la_activity_task_relation relation left join la_activity_user_task_record taskRecord on taskRecord.activity_id = relation.activity_id and relation.task_item_id = taskRecord.task_item_id and taskRecord.is_delete = 0 and taskRecord.user_id = #{userId} where relation.is_delete = 0 and taskRecord.id is null and relation.activity_id = #{activityId} order by relation.sorts limit 1
